name: wwilson1017-skills
description: Skills for Claude Code: page-based interviews, slide decks, recaps, handoffs, competing plans, unlisted pages, and site redos.

plugins.name: grill-me-page
plugins.description: Run a grill as one web page answered in a single sitting, with ★ recommendations, mockups, own-words answers and a collector that returns the answers to the session.

plugins.name: deck
plugins.description: Build browser slide decks and publish to Simple Sites, open from disk or use any static host.

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: Refresh stale state, then report the goal, the verified state, what's blocked, and owner-tagged next steps. Read-only.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a handoff document to the OS temp directory so a fresh agent can continue the work.

plugins.name: plan-fresh-eyes
plugins.description: Spawn an independent agent to write a competing plan from session context alone, then compare both plans.

plugins.name: webpage
plugins.description: Publish an unlisted Markdown or HTML page on Simple Sites, and update, take down, or restore it.

plugins.name: site-redo
plugins.description: Take a small business from their current website to a clickable beta.
